baseline_models.focus_anchor: The linked sequence يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَ...يَقْطَعُونَ...يُفْسِدُونَ and its paired outcomes.
baseline_models.mechanism: A covenant is a secured relation kept alive by repeated care. Undoing that construction and severing its continuities pushes the shared field out of order; expulsion and an encircling adverse condition are the resulting topology, not unrelated penalties.

activation_trace.role: Undoing a finished construction makes breach the dismantling of an already built order.
Repeated care makes the covenant a maintained relation rather than a one-time utterance.
A confirmed compact supplies the prior stabilization that the breach reverses.
Relational estrangement gives the cut its social and connective force.
Obligatory direction marks the connection as assigned rather than optional.
Sustained relation and abandonment of estrangement define what the severance destroys.
Departure from fitness and balance names the system-level effect of those cuts.
Expulsion from good externalizes the disconnection enacted by the agents.
An adverse circle or condition makes the bad abode an encompassing consequence.

changed_reading.before: Three offenses are followed by two punishments.
changed_reading.after: One maintained relational order is deliberately unbuilt: severance propagates as corruption, then returns as expulsion into an adverse enclosure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِن بَعْدِ مِيثَاقِهِ and the reopening sense available in يَنقُضُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The temporal phrase makes the failure post-stabilization. The breach can be pictured as a healed opening that breaks open again because an established compact ceased to receive the care that preserves it.

activation_trace.role: Sequence after a prior state makes ratification temporally antecedent to failure.
A wound reopening after closure pictures breach as relapse after apparent repair.
Recurrent tending supplies the maintenance whose withdrawal permits relapse.
Reinforcement establishes that the prior state had been made firm.
Attachment supplies the closed join that can reopen.
Loss of sound condition is the widening effect of the relapse.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes an original refusal to enter covenant.
changed_reading.after: It foregrounds relapse: a bond already confirmed and apparently closed is reopened through failed upkeep.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The binding, cutting, joint, and ground images latent in مِيثَاق، يَنقُضُونَ، يَقْطَعُونَ، يُوصَلَ، and الأرض.
baseline_models.mechanism: The compact can be carried as a tension-bearing assembly. Binding holds separated members together; strain sounds through its joints before a cut transfers failure into the ground that supports the whole.

activation_trace.role: A fastening rope supplies the material bond that holds the assembly together.
Creaking joints or a burdened back makes hidden strain audible before collapse.
Physical severance supplies the terminal failure of a loaded member.
Joints and separately articulated bones locate failure at the interfaces of the whole.
The lower supporting ground receives the propagated failure.
Encircling structure turns the abode into the assembly that ultimately contains them.

changed_reading.before: Breach is a purely propositional rejection.
changed_reading.after: Breach is also progressive structural failure: neglected tension becomes audible at joints, then a decisive cut destabilizes the supporting field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is the exact negative image of the immediately preceding profile. Completion, non-unbinding, continued relation, and patient restraint are reversed into undoing, cutting, and corruption, so the actors knowingly invert a practiced order rather than merely omit scattered duties.

activation_trace.role: Full completion without deficiency supplies the positive covenant posture being reversed.
Maintained care identifies fulfillment as ongoing covenant upkeep.
Refusal to unbuild the compact states the positive side of the focus's exact reversal.
The confirmed compact is the shared object on both sides of the mirror.
Sustained relation supplies the positive action that cutting negates.
Self-restraint supplies the endurance by which fragile relations are preserved.
Estrangement performs the direct inverse of the preceding continued relation.
Systemic loss of fitness is the aggregate result of reversing the whole profile.

structural_cues: 13:20-21 and 13:25 repeat covenant, unbinding, command, and connection lexemes with opposite predicates.
13:22-24 places patient repair and a good abode immediately before corruption and a bad abode.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical mirror and patient positive profile; I infer that failed endurance converts exact reversals into systemic corruption; alternatively, patience may remain a neighboring virtue rather than a causal maintenance practice.

changed_reading.before: The focus lists generic wrongdoers after an unrelated reward scene.
changed_reading.after: The focus names a deliberate counterprofile whose clauses reverse the maintained practices just displayed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The good abode is an open relational architecture: reconciled generations enter together and messengers enter through every gate in peace. Against it, cutting what should connect produces a bad abode as a closed or fragmented household, not only a remote address.

activation_trace.role: Repeated entry makes the rewarded space permeable and relationally accessible.
Removal of estrangement lets kin inhabit the shared destination together.
A counterpart joined to its pair supplies one household bond.
Smallness spreading outward extends the house through descendants.
Every entrance gives the good abode multiple maintained interfaces.
Freedom from harm names the condition produced by those open relations.
Estrangement closes the relational passages that the prior scene opens.
An adverse encircling condition renders the severed household itself punitive.

structural_cues: The focus follows a multi-generational entry scene with repeated يدخلون and كل باب.
عقبى الدار becomes سوء الدار after the connective verbs reverse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies joined kin, repeated entry, every gate, and peace; I infer an inverse closed-house topology for severance; alternatively, the two houses may contrast only final destinies without describing present social architecture.

changed_reading.before: سوء الدار means only a bad place awaiting the offenders.
changed_reading.after: It can also be the relational house their cuts construct: fragmented, inaccessible, and unable to gather generations in peace.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's land works through extended channels, adjacency, shared roots, irrigation shares, valleys, and beneficial persistence. These images activate الوصل as circulation infrastructure; cutting assigned links then corrupts the land by interrupting flows that let distinct parts remain jointly fertile.

activation_trace.role: Drawing something out until it connects supplies the land's extended connective substrate.
Neighboring proximity makes distinct plots function within one shared field.
Branches issuing from one root model plurality sustained by a common source.
A share of irrigation and its channel supplies the distributive connection.
A valley as a watercourse gives flow a bounded path through the land.
Beneficial stability in place marks what a working circulation leaves embedded.
Fertility, settlement, and connected land make joining materially life-supporting.
Loss of fitness names the downstream condition when those channels are interrupted.

structural_cues: Land, water, channels, neighboring plots, and shared sources recur before the focus's في الأرض.
The focus orders cutting, joining, and land corruption as a causal-looking sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flow, adjacency, shared roots, irrigation channels, and persistence; I infer an analogy from material circulation to social and legal connection; alternatively, the land scenes may illustrate signs without specifying the focus's human network.

changed_reading.before: Connection is an abstract moral relation and land corruption is a separate broad offense.
changed_reading.after: Connection can be read as circulation infrastructure whose severance makes both social and material fields lose fertility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The flood-and-smelting scene sorts floating excess from benefit that remains embedded in earth. It activates the focus's curse as congruent expulsion: agents who sever attachment become cast-off matter, while what sustains connection remains grounded.

activation_trace.role: Floating froth supplies disconnected surface excess awaiting separation.
What is cast away supplies the physical sorting movement.
Benefit names the contrasting material retained by the system.
Stable remaining gives useful matter durable attachment.
Productive earth is the receiving matrix in which benefit stays.
Expulsion from good mirrors the prior casting-away motion.
Attachment distinguishes integrated benefit from floating excess.

structural_cues: 13:17 explicitly contrasts cast-off froth with benefit remaining in earth before 13:25 pairs severance, corruption in earth, and expulsion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a material sorting pattern and an expulsion outcome; I infer that enacted disconnection makes the offenders fit the cast-off side of that pattern; alternatively, the foam parable may concern truth and falsehood without mapping onto covenant sociology.

changed_reading.before: The curse is an externally appended verbal sentence.
changed_reading.after: The curse also completes a sorting logic: practiced disconnection culminates in being disconnected and cast out.

context_deltas.mechanism: Writing, erasure, proof, judgment, and accounting activate the covenant as an inspectable public order. Breaking after ratification and cutting its assigned claims is therefore not merely private disloyalty; it dismembers an order whose terms and consequences can be established and adjudicated.

activation_trace.role: An inscription that establishes binding judgment supplies the register's normative force.
Removal of an effect makes alteration of the record visible rather than assumed.
Proof and establishment supply the counter-operation that secures an entry or claim.
Judgment between parties turns the maintained order into an adjudicable relation.
Counting and accounting make consequences answerable to an ordered reckoning.
An advance instruction deposited for preservation supplies document-like custody.
Confirmed ratification gives the covenant formal stability before breach.
Separating a matter or right locates the cut in a legal field of claims.

structural_cues: كتاب frames the surah and recurs with fixed terms, erasure, establishment, judgment, and حساب.
The focus stresses breach only after ميثاق, foregrounding prior ratification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inscription, alteration, proof, judgment, accounting, and a confirmed compact; I infer a public-register mechanism joining them; alternatively, كتاب may remain revelation or decree rather than a literal covenant ledger.

changed_reading.before: The covenant is a private promise whose breach is chiefly interpersonal.
changed_reading.after: It is also a ratified and adjudicable order: severing its claims is an attack on the public grammar that records obligations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Early land-pieces can remain productive through adjacency, but the late image of land diminished from its edges activates a different cutting regime. The focus's corruption can therefore be cumulative attrition: repeated diminutions of rights and relations shrink the viable common field from its margins inward.

activation_trace.role: Distinct land-pieces show that partition itself can coexist with productive adjacency.
Repeated diminution of a right supplies the incremental mode of damage.
An edge or endpoint locates attrition at the common field's vulnerable margins.
A separated piece gives each breach a fragmenting material result.
Fertile earth supplies the viable whole that repeated edge loss impoverishes.
Departure from sound order names the cumulative condition rather than only one event.

structural_cues: 13:4 presents adjacent قطع of land, whereas 13:41 presents land losing its أطراف.
The focus places repeated-form verbs before فساد, allowing accumulated action rather than a single rupture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies productive partition, edge reduction, and a branch of repeated right-diminution; I infer that relational cuts can aggregate into common-domain shrinkage; alternatively, 13:41 may depict divine territorial encroachment rather than human ecological attrition.

changed_reading.before: Any boundary or partition is equivalent to the condemned cutting.
changed_reading.after: The verse condemns cuts that erode assigned connection; bounded plurality can remain fruitful, while repeated rights-loss contracts the common world.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated outcome, return, and circulation language reactivates الدار beyond static residence. The bad abode can be a returning circuit in which severance circulates back to its makers as an adverse condition, while the good circuit gathers and returns people toward a sound home.

activation_trace.role: The final consequence supplies the outcome pole paired with the abode.
Circulation of conditions lets the good abode name an achieved state as well as a place.
Habitual return supplies an active movement toward the destination.
Return to a home or place makes مآب a relational homecoming.
Recurrent final consequence closes the surah's action-outcome arc.
The circulation of conditions repeats the abode as a feedback state.
An adverse circle gives سوء الدار the negative form of that returning circuit.
What causes distress qualifies the circuit as experientially harmful.

structural_cues: عقبى الدار appears before and after the focus, while أناب and مآب intensify return language nearby.
The focus's paired لهم constructions make the adverse condition belong back to its makers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated consequence, homecoming, and circulation branches; I infer a feedback arrow from enacted severance to a returning adverse state; alternatively, الدار can retain the ordinary static sense of final abode.

changed_reading.before: The bad abode is only a location reached later.
changed_reading.after: It can coexist as a feedback circuit: the pattern of disconnection returns and encloses those who enact it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet distinguishes destructive severance from form-giving articulation. Writing joins units, detailing separates so boundaries become legible, and judgment restrains for repair; the focus therefore condemns cutting specifically where connection was commanded, not every distinction, boundary, or tailored division.

activation_trace.role: Joining one unit to another makes a written whole through composition.
Separation that reveals a boundary supplies constructive articulation rather than rupture.
Restraint and return for repair give judgment a boundary-preserving function.
Tailoring cloth shows a cut can form a useful whole when governed by pattern.
A patterned textile supplies the whole within which fitted divisions remain connected.
Unweaving or undoing construction distinguishes ruin from disciplined articulation.

structural_cues: The relative clause ما أمر...أن يوصل restricts the condemned cutting to an assigned connection.
تفصيل الآيات and حكم عربي place legitimate differentiation elsewhere in the same surah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies compositional writing, revealing separation, reparative restraint, tailoring, and textile branches; I infer a criterion of pattern-governed articulation; alternatively, the textile images may be lexical echoes without interpretive force here.

changed_reading.before: The focus rejects separation and boundary-making as such.
changed_reading.after: It rejects unpatterned severance of an assigned bond while leaving room for distinctions that articulate, adjudicate, or preserve a larger whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier condition linking collective change to change within selves, followed by the alternative of settled hearts, activates breach as an embodied inner reversal. The outward cuts disclose a prior reconfiguration of the self after ratification, and the bad condition follows that enacted change rather than arriving arbitrarily.

activation_trace.role: Changing a form or replacing it supplies the transition between inner and collective states.
The self as the thing itself locates the initiating alteration within the agents.
Stillness and assurance supply the live alternative to inner destabilization.
The heart provides the interior site whose settled or reversed condition becomes action.
After-ness makes the inward reversal occur subsequent to confirmed commitment.
Reopening after closure externalizes the changed inner state as relapse.
Collective loss of soundness is the propagated outer condition.

structural_cues: 13:11 repeats change at the collective and inner-self levels before the focus's repeated active verbs.
13:28 repeats settled hearts as a nearby alternative state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a condition between self-change and collective change plus a settled-heart alternative; I infer that covenant acts embody an inner reversal; alternatively, 13:11 need not explain every later punishment as a deterministic causal law.

changed_reading.before: The curse descends arbitrarily after external rule violations.
changed_reading.after: The external severances manifest a post-ratification change within the agents, and the adverse state is continuous with that enacted reversal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Invisible support, elevated structure, and carried load sharpen the focus-only mechanical reading. A covenant may do quiet load-bearing work before anyone notices it; breaking appears first as strain at joints, then as failure of the relations that held a common world aloft.

activation_trace.role: Raising a structure supplies the elevated whole whose stability requires support.
A supporting column supplies the quiet load-bearing function even where support is unseen.
Carrying a visible load gives the system material stress to distribute.
A fastening rope holds loaded members in relation.
A creaking back or joint under weight reveals strain before rupture.
Articulated joints locate where distributed support can fail.

structural_cues: The surah opens with an elevated order and unseen columns, later shows carried flood-load, and the focus clusters binding, undoing, cutting, and joining.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies support, elevation, carrying, fastening, and joint-strain images; I infer that covenant relations bear social load; alternatively, these domains may remain independent cosmological and lexical images.

changed_reading.before: A covenant matters only when explicitly invoked or litigated.
changed_reading.after: It may be invisible support whose neglected strain precedes visible social and terrestrial collapse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the مكر watering branch is form-distant from plotting and the route-to-water branch of صدّ is narrower than ordinary obstruction. It remains anchored in the focus's cutting, required joining, and earth-corruption and in 13:33's joined syntax of adornment, plotting, and blocking the path. Render it only as a cross-domain exploratory overlay, never as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَقْطَعُونَ مَا...أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ.

activation_trace.role: Displayed improvement lets damage acquire an attractive surface.
Watering land and crops supplies a startling counterfeit-cultivation image.
A route to water turns obstruction into blocked access to a sustaining flow.
A traversable extended road supplies the connective route being obstructed.
Road-cutting by obstruction anchors the sabotage directly in the condemned cut.
Loss of land's sound condition is the hidden result beneath the improved appearance.

changed_reading.before: Corruption is visibly ruinous and announces itself as hostility to the land.
changed_reading.after: A live exploratory possibility is beautified infrastructural sabotage: an act can look like cultivation while blocking the routes that actually carry sustenance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it couples a positive local use of entry with the branch image of inward corruption and uses the earth-root's wood-eater image materially. It remains anchored in فساد في الأرض and the unbuilding sense of نقض, with surface/interior contrast supplied nearby. Render as an analogy for concealed decay, not as a claim that 13:23's entrants are corrupt.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَنقُضُونَ...وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ as concealed interior decay becoming visible collapse.

activation_trace.role: Inwardly hidden corruption supplies decay located inside an apparently standing structure.
Outward appearance supplies the surface that can conceal interior failure.
A wood-eating earth-creature gives hidden corruption a slow material agent.
Unbuilding makes the concealed consumption legible only when construction fails.
Departure from sound condition anchors the infestation image in the focus's explicit predicate.

changed_reading.before: Breach and corruption are overt public acts visible at once.
changed_reading.after: They may also describe slow interior consumption of covenant structure whose damage becomes visible only at collapse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the anatomical joints branch of وصل and reads the family sequence as one extended body. It remains anchored in the focus's explicit cut/join opposition and in packet-supplied womb, growth, spouses, and descendants. Render as a contained embodied analogy alongside, not instead of, social and legal connection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The object of يَقْطَعُونَ...أَن يُوصَلَ read through bodily articulation and generational continuity.

activation_trace.role: Hidden pregnancy supplies embodied continuity before a descendant appears.
Kinship makes the womb's continuity simultaneously bodily and social.
Growth extends the living chain rather than merely repeating it.
A joined counterpart supplies the lateral bond of the extended body.
Small particles spreading give descendants a branching material image.
Joints and separately articulated bones make connection the integrity of one body.
Cutting kinship becomes disarticulation of that intergenerational body.

changed_reading.before: The commanded connection is only an abstract institutional tie.
changed_reading.after: It can also be carried as an intergenerational body whose wombs, pairs, descendants, and joints preserve living continuity; estrangement dismembers it.

strongest_changes: 13:25 is an exact counterprofile to 13:20-24, not a loose catalog after an unrelated reward scene.
Joining became circulation infrastructure across social, hydrological, household, and legal domains, while corruption became propagated system failure.
The curse and bad abode gained sorting and feedback readings: enacted disconnection returns as expulsion and adverse enclosure.
The focus condemns cuts that violate assigned connection, not every productive boundary, articulation, or distinction.
Repeated edge loss and hidden strain preserve slower modes of failure alongside sudden breach.
summary.what_was_special: The packet sustained coexisting readings at different scales: maintained compact, relapsed wound, loaded structure, irrigated field, open household, adjudicated register, returning circuit, and embodied lineage. Branch-distant images were retained with containment instead of being flattened into one consensus interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus does not enumerate the full scope of what was commanded to be connected.
Hydraulic, architectural, anatomical, and register mechanisms depend on reader-supplied cross-domain arrows even when every element is packet-backed.
The circulation branch of الدار may sharpen consequence and feedback without displacing the ordinary sense of abode.
The مكر, دخول, and earth-creature outliers require explicit exploratory qualification because their branch images are distant from local syntax.
